data.long_meaning: One who is adorned with beauty and charm. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haseena total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حسينة
in_arabic.meaning: حسينة تعني الجميلة والحسنة في الأخلاق والشكل
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسينة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'حَسُنَ' الذي يعني الجمال والكمال. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الزمر الآية 55 'وَيَومَ يَرى الْمُؤْمِنونَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ أَتباعَهُم مُحَقَّقينَ يَقولونَ سَلامٌ عَلَينا لا يَمسُسُنا الضَرّاءُ وَأَتبَعوا الذِّكرى الحَسَنَةَ'

in_urdu.name: حسیہ
in_urdu.meaning: حسیہ کا مطلب خوبصورت اور اچھے اخلاق والی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسیہ ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث اسم ہے، جو 'حَسُنَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور مکمل پن۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اچھے اخلاق اور حسن کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसीना
in_hindi.meaning: हसीना का अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसीना एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'حَسُنَ' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और पूर्णता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अच्छे चरित्र और सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: حسينة
in_pashto.meaning: حسينة يعني ښکلایي او په اخلاقو ښه والی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسينة د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی، چې د 'حَسُنَ' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده ښکلا او بشپړتیا. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې دي.

in_english.name: Haseena
in_english.long_meaning: Haseena is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'حَسُنَ' (hasuna) meaning 'to be beautiful' or 'to be good'. It signifies a person with good character and beauty, both inner and outer. The name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of good character and righteous living.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haseena carries in Islama a strong cultural significance as it implies beauty, grace, and admiration. In South Asian and Middle Eastern cultures, it is a popular name for a precious daughter. The beauty of the name emanates not only in its literal meaning but also in the way it is reverentially pronounced.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Haseena holds a deeper meaning. It represents the inner beauty that comes from living a good life, pleasing Allah and striving towards excellence. It is a reminder of Hajjaj Ibn Yusuf at-Thaqafi, who despite possessing physical beauty, was characterised by exquisite piety, humility, and devotion. Thus, Haseena transcends the physical realm and reminds us of the importance of inner and moral grandeur.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Beauty, attractive" symbolizes One who is adorned with beauty and charm. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Haseena serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of beauty, attractive.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph of Islam and cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Haseena carried significant weight in that era.
